messages:
Rita (CS): Quick sync note from today's Helio Health triage. Renewal in ~30 days. They reported two main blockers: 1) sudden embeddings latency after bulk ingest, 2) invoices lack per-route clarity so finance can't reconcile costs. They want a route-level export and a short runbook.

Owen: Which deployment and model? Any repro?

Rita (CS): Dedicated `hh-prod-01`, model open-llama-7b int8. Repro: run bulk-embed (150k docs) then user queries; some queries jump to ~2s. Zendesk HH-9001 attached.

Priya (PM): Priorities: A) Per-route CSV export = quick unblock (P0). B) Latency investigation = P1. C) Docs + enablement call = P1 low effort.

Marcus: I can spike the export today: endpoint `/api/v1/usage/export?workspace_id=&route=`. CSV cols: route, tokens_in, tokens_out, est_cost_usd, model_variant, start_ts, end_ts. ETA PR by EOD, staging tomorrow.

Rita (CS): Please include deployment_type column. Also scheduling a 30m repro session with Helio tomorrow 10am PT to capture traces (they'll run with REDWOOD_DEBUG=1).

BillingBot: Ticket HH-9001 created, owner assigned: Rita (CS).

Priya (PM): Action items: Marcus to deliver CSV spike; Rita to collect traces; I'll draft short mitigation doc (suggest smaller model, tune batch size, throttle concurrency) and an enablement agenda. Recommend offering one-time credit if export isn't live before renewal.

Owen: Once traces are up, I'll check kernel selection + cache pressure. If quick export + playbook delivered, we can move renewal state from at-risk to monitoring.

Rita (CS): I'll post the trace link here after the session. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
